source: gun_effect.BIN (archive 0: ModelSet 0 projectile, 1 muzzle flash); bomb_effect.BIN and pod_effect.BIN (archive 0 ModelSet 0 bomb / pod, archive 1 ModelSet 0 explosion); leg_effect.BIN per legs part (step / boost / land particle joints); attack_effect.BIN per body (charge aura, impact)

leg.index: legs part id (player part table 0x801C5BD0+16p, +0xA); no legs-record field or body id changes the effect. Pack entries 16-33 are copies of entry 0, so dummy legs ids use legs 0's effect

step.attach: bone 17 foot_R world matrix (R+0x1794); floor material 4 uses efc_common A3 instead

boost.trigger: first tick of any boosting robo state (0 jump press, 3/4 airborne fire/bomb, 6, 7, 8 air dash, 9, 10, 11) while the boost ramp B+0xA8 is 0
boost.attach: legs locators 4 and 6 (legs root 4 / 5, path 2,2 = (4,0,0) in root space, local Z along root X = down the shin); matrix re-copied every tick
boost.stop: ramp falls 0.05/tick after the last boosting tick (20 ticks from full), then psKillGenerators; or anim end (600)

land.attach: translation = robo floor position R+0x20, rest rotation

charge.trigger: state 12 entry (charge attack button R+0x242 & 0x40, grounded)
charge.attach: root = robo world matrix R+0x194 every frame
charge.stop: state 12 ends or the robo is hit (drawing stops; generators are not killed)

impact.attach: attacker centre R+0x30, robo facing (R+0x170..0x178), uniform scale R+0x1C4
